note: Required 20-30 s acting test: Ryan explains with full confidence, Maya amused -> sceptical -> eyebrow, Ryan notices and pauses, Maya corrects, Ryan confused -> embarrassed, Maya laughs, Ryan defends himself. Fact: 1 yen = about 0.63 US cents at ~159.7 yen per dollar; Japan's 5 and 50 yen coins have holes.

beats.text: Okay, so here's how it works. In Japan, everything costs thousands. Thousands! So the yen must be super valuable.
beats.act: the young man on the left explains with total confidence, leaning in slightly, counting on his fingers and gesturing toward the woman
beats.react: the woman on the right listens with a small amused smile that slowly fades into a sceptical look, mouth closed

beats.act: the woman on the right says nothing and slowly raises one eyebrow at him, arms folding
beats.react: the young man on the left notices her look, stops gesturing mid-air and pauses, his confident smile freezing

beats.text: ...What? Why are you doing the eyebrow?
beats.act: the young man on the left lowers his hands slowly and asks warily
beats.react: the woman on the right keeps one eyebrow raised, a tiny knowing smile, mouth closed

beats.text: Ryan. It's the opposite. Prices look big because each yen is tiny. One yen is a little over half a cent.
beats.act: the woman on the right explains calmly with a small open-hand gesture toward him, head tilted
beats.react: the young man on the left listens, his face slowly going from confident to confused, eyebrows pulling together, mouth closed

beats.act: the young man on the left repeats it slowly in disbelief, looking down at his hands
beats.react: the woman on the right nods slowly, pressing her lips together to hide a smile, mouth closed

beats.text: So I've been bragging about being rich... in pennies.
beats.act: the young man on the left looks away awkwardly, embarrassed, rubbing the back of his neck
beats.react: the woman on the right tries not to laugh, mouth closed

beats.act: the woman on the right laughs warmly and shakes her head
beats.react: the young man on the left gives a sheepish half-smile, mouth closed

beats.text: Okay, but they're very nice pennies. Some of them have holes in them!
beats.act: the young man on the left recovers, defending himself with a nervous laugh and a hopeful shrug
beats.react: the woman on the right covers a laugh with her hand, amused, mouth closed
